trigger: A named delivery claim depends on evidence produced by multiple ordered CI steps.
mustNever: A job-level success directly promotes a stronger named claim.
An early proof file is silently treated as if it contained a later step result.
Missing final closure is converted to ALLOW by ignoring absent or false fields.
A technical publication claim is expanded into iPhone, visual, Game-baseline or user acceptance.
requiredEvidence: path and SHA-256 for every consumed evidence atom
independent verifier identity or explicit UNKNOWN
activationGate: One real Mother implementation of a post-critical-step finalizer plus an independent verifier GATE-RUN; coordinator review required before wider activation.
